get_model_complexity_info: get FLOPs and parameter counts for a PyTorch model with per-layer statistics printed to stdout
flops_to_string: convert a raw FLOPs number into a human-readable string with units like GFLOPs or MFLOPs
params_to_string: convert a raw parameter count into a human-readable string with units like M or K
print_model_with_flops: print a PyTorch model with per-layer FLOPs and parameter counts alongside each module
get_model_parameters_number: calculate the total number of trainable parameters in a PyTorch model
